en.headline: Bernadette Linn expects construction volume to rise with Northern Metropolis
en.dek: The Development Secretary told a construction industry awards ceremony that the sector needs talent skilled in advanced technology and AI as project workload is set to increase in the coming years.
body: Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said on Saturday that construction workload is expected to keep rising in the next few years as Northern Metropolis development enters a peak phase, creating strong demand for industry talent.

Speaking at a construction industry awards ceremony, Linn said the sector has been actively adopting advanced building technologies and is gradually moving into a new generation of artificial intelligence and robotics. This not only improves efficiency and safety but also drives higher-quality development across the industry.

She stressed that further competitiveness hinges on people who keep pace with technology and embrace innovation. Young people should inherit solid craftsmanship while mastering frontier skills and maintaining a rigorous, public-spirited attitude.

The government would continue to invest heavily in training to support young people’s long-term careers in construction, she added, encouraging the industry to prepare for the substantial pipeline of projects ahead.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪料北都發展帶動工程量上升
zh.dek: 發展局局長在建造業界頒獎禮表示，未來數年工程量持續上升，業界需積極裝備人才迎接前景。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪周六出席建造業界頒獎典禮時表示，隨著北部都會區發展進入高峰，預計未來數年工程量會持續上升，對建造業人才需求殷切。
她說，建造業界近年積極推動大量先進建築技術，改革轉型正邁向人工智能和機械人的新世代，不但提升效益和安全，更推動整個業界走向更高質素發展。
甯漢豪強調，要進一步提升競爭力，關鍵是人才，尤其是與時並進善用科技、擁抱創新的人才。她期望年青一代既要傳承扎實工藝根基，亦要掌握前沿科技，並抱有嚴謹做好本份、貢獻社會的態度。
她表示，為支持年青人在建造業長遠發展，政府會繼續投入大量資源做好培訓工作，鼓勵業界積極裝備自己，迎接未來大量工程和亮麗前景。
